description: Branch R-SORT-3 Length510 boundary, Memo keys, on an ACCDB. MA(ID, M Memo) with non-unique IX_M built before the rows: per length n of 100, 254, 255, 256, 257, 300 and 1000 two values, m x n + 'x' and m x n + 'y' (a change only at the last unit), and for n = 300 a control with the change at the first unit. MB(ID, M Memo) gets CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_M on the empty table (its result is read) and then the same rows with a marked Errors read per row. Reads IX_M's DistinctCount, GROUP BY M (first ID, count), the SQL equality pairs, and the walk of IX_M. Asks the Memo key prefix length (the earlier unique-index refusals and the DistinctCount of 6 are consistent with 255 but did not measure it) and whether a unique index on Memo is admitted.

args.text: CREATE TABLE MA (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_MA PRIMARY KEY, M MEMO)
CREATE TABLE MB (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_MB PRIMARY KEY, M MEMO)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_M ON MB (M)
SELECT MIN(ID), COUNT(*), MAX(ID) FROM MA GROUP BY M ORDER BY M
SELECT A.ID, B.ID FROM MA AS A INNER JOIN MA AS B ON A.M = B.M WHERE A.ID < B.ID
SELECT ID FROM MB ORDER BY ID
